Rohit Chatterjee
Senior Vue.js Developer | Secunderabad
rohit.chatterjee698@example.com | +91 9299159573

Experienced frontend engineer focused on building scalable, performant single-page applications and server-side rendered frontends. Strong track record delivering enterprise dashboards and logistics customer portals with measurable improvements in performance and user engagement. Not open to relocation; looking for roles in Secunderabad only. Notice period: 60 days.

Experience

Tata Consultancy Services — Feb 2019 - Present
Senior Vue.js Developer (Onsite/Remote)
- Led development of a customer analytics dashboard using Vue.js and Nuxt.js, implementing server-side rendering that reduced first-contentful paint by 48% and improved SEO-driven traffic by 22%.
- Architected component library and state patterns in JavaScript for reuse across 6 projects, decreasing feature delivery time by 35% and lowering defect rates by 18%.
- Implemented automated end-to-end and unit test pipelines for Nuxt.js apps on Linux CI runners, increasing release cadence to biweekly while maintaining 99% automated test pass rates.
- Mentored 8 frontend engineers on Vue.js performance best practices and JavaScript patterns, resulting in a 30% reduction in production bugs for the team.

Bluefin Logistics — Dec 2011 - Jan 2019
Frontend Developer (Onsite)
- Rebuilt customer booking and tracking portal using Nuxt.js and Tailwind CSS, improving mobile conversion by 27% and reducing page weight by 40%.
- Implemented responsive UI components and utility-first styling with Tailwind CSS, standardizing UI across 12 modules and cutting CSS maintenance time by 50%.
- Optimized client-side JavaScript bundles and lazy-loaded routes, reducing average route load time from 1.2s to 0.6s and improving user satisfaction scores.
- Managed deployment and troubleshooting on Linux servers for staging and production builds, achieving 99.5% uptime during peak shipment seasons.

Projects

Personal UI Component Library
- Designed a reusable Vue.js component library with Nuxt.js integration and Tailwind CSS theming; adopted internally at two clients to accelerate prototyping.

Offline Parcel Tracker (side project)
- Built a lightweight Nuxt.js PWA that caches tracking data for offline use; reduced data fetches by 60% for users in low-connectivity areas.
